name: ModelVariant409_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant409_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; a non-negative request selects the configuration record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, packs the textures and initialises the effect, otherwise it runs one frame through the sheet, streamer, mesh, ribbon and spiral helpers; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; US and Japanese header-409 images. The PAL header-426 entry is FrenchModelVariant426_HandleRequest. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect.
